title: Business Requirements Document — what are the objective

sections.title: 1. Technical Introduction (Purpose, Scope, Definitions)
sections.body:
This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) is generated based on the provided project title 'what are the objective' and the verified audit findings. 

**Purpose:** The purpose of this document is to define the functional and non-functional requirements for the system. 

**Scope:** The scope of this system is currently undefined. The source document excerpt is empty, and the verified audit findings indicate no specific modules, features, or stakeholders. 

**Definitions:** No specific technical definitions are provided in the source material. Standard IEEE 830 terminology applies.

sections.title: 4. Non-Functional Requirements (Performance, Security, Reliability mapped to domain standards)
sections.body:
Based on the GENERIC_ENTERPRISE domain profile, the following standard NFR benchmarks apply to this system:

- **Performance:** P95 latency targets must be < 250ms.
- **Reliability:** The system must meet a 99.9% uptime SLA.
- **Security:** Data encryption must utilize AES-256 standards.

These benchmarks are derived from the domain profile and serve as the baseline for system performance and security verification.

sections.body: No external interface requirements are specified in the source material. The verified audit findings do not list any APIs, user interfaces, or hardware dependencies. This section is an open item requiring stakeholder input to define system boundaries and external integrations.

sections.title: 6. System Constraints & Compliance Verification
sections.body:
The system must comply with the following frameworks as defined in the domain profile:

- **SOC 2:** Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy.
- **GDPR:** Applicable if personal data is processed.
- **ISO 27001:** Information Security Management System (ISMS) standards.

No specific compliance constraints or verification methods are detailed in the source material. Stakeholder input is required to map specific system components to these compliance frameworks.
